222-527-8227-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-8227-8296.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
222-527-8227-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Loot twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

339-647-677-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

7084-7422-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

5900-7399-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-7399-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

1479-2841-7705-8098.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Mountain Valley.
[
1479-2841-7705-8098.description:
Fetch a land using Mountain Valley.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

112-757-2348-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
112-757-2348-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Clockspinning to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1409-1849-3099-3755.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

412-413-3081-3817.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 5.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger from step 3, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Ancestor's Chosen trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4050-4182-6747-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
4050-4182-6747-7639.description:
Cast Whispers of the Muse by paying {U} due to Sami.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2292-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 4.

250-779-1479-3678-6620.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3678-6620.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

967-3809-4772-5256-7087.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

1492-4195-4574-6918.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-4195-4574-6918.description:
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Welding Jar from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Welding Jar from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

132-3750-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to red is at least five
132-3750-4306.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

1395-1987-4002-4423.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
You control three or more lands that share a name.
1395-1987-4002-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Ghostly Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1306-1661-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Crypt.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

789-2399-6798--129.easyPrerequisites: Gutter Grime has slime counters on it at least equal to the toughness of the creature card in your hand.
789-2399-6798--129.description:
Cast the creature card in your hand by paying {0}.
Either that creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness, or activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing that creature.
Gutter Grime triggers, putting a slime counter on it and creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Ooze.
When the Ooze dies, Colfenor triggers, returning the creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot abilities, surveiling 1 each time.
Repeat.
789-2399-6798--129.notes: This combo also puts infinite slime counters on Gutter Grime, allowing you to easily create additional infinitely large creature tokens.

1336-1636-4050-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 4 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
1336-1636-4050-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
When Sin enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sin, adding {G/U}.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Heronblade Elite.
Activate Heronblade Elite by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to its power.
Repeat.

589-2919-5796.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
589-2919-5796.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
589-2919-5796.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

261-1274-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-1274-3197.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-5089-5668-5902-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

1365-3263-4853-5330--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-3263-4853-5330--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

1637-3505-4423-4826-5226.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Plains.
Archelos is untapped.
1637-3505-4423-4826-5226.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains by tapping them, adding at least {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Lithatog's second ability three times by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary and two Plains, giving Lithatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Cast Second Sunrise by paying {1}{W}{W}, returning all land cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
When each land enters the battlefield, Aesi triggers that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary triggers once.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Second Sunrise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
If you control additional lands, you may sacrifice them as well to get additional mana and triggers.

360-1981-2773.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
360-1981-2773.description:
Cast Soul Warden by paying {W}.
When Soul Warden enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

4050-4294-5220.description:
Cast Etali by paying {5}{R}{R}.
When Etali enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Etali, adding one mana of any color.
When Etali dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 2, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 2.

230-4050-4666-4893.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-4050-4666-4893.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
Planar Void triggers, exiling the card put into the graveyard.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {G}.
Repeat.

375-967-4166-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters the battlefield, Hedron Detonator triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Hedron Detonator trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Ob Nixilis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, and exiling Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library with the ability to cast it from exile until your end step.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}.
Prosper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2751-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, targeting any artifact.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Resolve the copy of Mishra's ability, creating a token copy of Strionic Resonator that is a 4/4 creature with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by paying {2}, and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Strionic Resonator.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mishra's Warform, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

710-1703-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

678-3944.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blood Pet to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1308-1912-2713-3883-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {U}, causing an opponent to draw a card.
Hullbreacher replaces the card drawn with you creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it to add {U}.
Repeat.

618-1061.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate token copy of Timestream Navigator by tapping it, paying {2}{U}{U}, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
